protocol.weakLabels: owner: about 80% of hitobject times have audible onsets; robust emission keeps the top 80% note scores
protocol.bands: full + low bins1-8 + mid9-32 + high33-127; 256-sample Hann, hop11, log positive spectral flux
protocol.phase: one phase per known redline segment, -30..30 ms by 0.5 ms; independent and DP variants
protocol.transitionPenalty: 0.0005 only when both adjacent redline durations are <=1200 ms; zero across long segments
protocol.validation: full fit is descriptive; crossFit trains on even hitobject indices and evaluates odd, then vice versa; jitter null follows the identical fit/evaluation path
protocol.evaluation: nearest full-band peak after phase correction, 20 ms suppression, +/-10 ms search; unmatched stays in denominator
protocol.limitation: Known redline boundaries and hitobject weak labels are used. This measures robust alignment consistency, not fully automatic discovery or independently annotated acoustic-onset accuracy.
